items.title: Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review Balogun ban
items.description: President Donald Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review United States striker Folarin Balogun's one-match suspension at the World Cup.

items.title: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 23 killed in Kyiv region
items.description: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.

items.title: Charlie Kirk's family attends hearing for suspect charged with his murder
items.description: Tyler Robinson, 23, is accused of murdering Kirk, a key Trump ally and founder of youth organisation Turning Point USA.

items.title: Ex-Syrian intelligence chief found guilty of torture and sexual abuse by Austrian court
items.description: Two former Syrian officials went on trial in Vienna, Austria, accused of crimes against opponents of former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad

items.title: Huge crowds fill Tehran streets for Khamenei's funeral procession
items.description: Many people were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance for the former supreme leader's war death.

items.title: Wildfire in southern France forces evacuation of 10,000 people
items.description: Tour de France organisers ban spectators from stage three as a wildfire hits the Pyrénées-Orientales region.

items.title: More than 1,000 arrested as part of global human trafficking crackdown
items.description: Interpol says the vast majority of the 2,070 victims or potential victims identified were women being trafficked for sex.

items.title: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
items.description: Fabiana was trapped in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes rocked Venezuela in June.

items.title: Sri Lanka prison riots leave 26 dead and more than 100 injured
items.description: The two days of violence at Negombo Prison are the worst prison riots in the country in years.

items.title: Marine Le Pen appeal verdict: Why this moment matters for France
items.description: The leader of France's National Rally leads the opinion polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election and will now find out if she can stand.

items.title: Australian PM apologises for 'inappropriate' comments about Kylie Minogue
items.description: Albanese has apologised 'unequivocally' after his remarks prompted a backlash.

items.title: Super Typhoon Bavi strikes US Pacific islands with pummeling winds
items.description: The storm lashed the Mariana Islands, hitting Rota and prompting emergency warnings on Guam.
